LanguageData.RG_EggDodoEggFertilized.label: dodo egg (fert.)
LanguageData.RG_EggDodoEggFertilized.description: A fertilized dodo egg. If all goes well, it should hatch into a dodo. It can be eaten raw, but it's much better cooked.
LanguageData.RG_EggDodoEggUnfertilized.label: dodo egg (unfert.)
LanguageData.RG_EggDodoEggUnfertilized.description: An unfertilized dodo egg. It can be eaten raw, but it's much, much better cooked.
